## Architecture Overview

The `Appender` interface in `prometheus/storage/interface.go` defines methods for writing time-series data. It currently includes Append, AppendHistogram, AppendExemplar, AppendCTZeroSample (already named AppendSTZeroSample in newer code), and UpdateMetadata. Adding AppendCTZeroSample requires all implementations to add this method.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`storage/interface.go`** — Main Appender interface definition.
- **`storage/interface_append.go`** — AppenderV2 interface with unified Append including start timestamp (st) parameter.
- **`storage/fanout.go`** — FanoutAppender wrapping multiple appenders (primary and secondaries).

### Prometheus Implementations

- **`tsdb/head_append.go`** — Head appender implementation.
- **`tsdb/head_append_v2.go`** — Head appender V2 for unified API.
- **`storage/remote/otlptranslator/prometheusremotewrite/combined_appender.go`** — CombinedAppender for OTLP-to-Prometheus translation with created timestamp handling.

### Mimir

- **`pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go`** — MimirAppender for OTLP metrics with created timestamp ingestion.
- **`pkg/ingester/ingester.go`** — Ingester using Appender for data ingestion.

### Thanos

- **`pkg/receive/writer.go`** — ReceiveAppender wrapper adding validation to storage.Appender.

### Loki

- **`pkg/ruler/base/compat.go`** — Compatibility layer using Appender for rule evaluation.

### OTel Collector Contrib

- **`receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/appendable.go`** — Appendable wrapper for Prometheus receiver integration.
